page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a centred italic heading above the second paragraph. No margin notes. Page number and running head at the top; a Greek phrase within the text.

main_text.p: esse habitos, frumentoque & opsoniis ex publico adjutos, ut eorum copiam in usus reipublicæ, cum primis verò in expeditiones maritimas ac minisferia nautica, quibus id genus hominum inops & durum maximè est idoneum, habere quovis tempore paratum civitas posset.

Fuisse autem in hac civitate senatum, velut ancoram concionis popularis, fuisse magistratus varios, ac judicum collegia, dubitari non potest. Sed qui ordo in his, quæ electionis & administrationis ratio fuerit, ignoratur. Senatus quidem hic illic in rebus Rhodiis fit mentio, ad quem negocia pleraque sunt relata. In magistratuum ordine prytanem fuisse, ac summum locum tenuisse, etiam in confesso est: fuisse autem se-mestrem tantum, ex uno Polybii loco clarere videtur, ubi de Stratocle sic loquitur, literas Lucretii prætoris Romani Rhodum allatas fuisse, Στρατοκλῆς [?] [illegible, ~20 letters]. Referebat utplurimum prytanes negocia ad concilia, locusque ubi ille potissimum de republicâ agebat, prytaneum diceba-

page.notes: The drop capital is read as F ("Fuisse"). The Greek phrase after "fuisse," is only partly legible: "Στρατοκλῆς" is doubtful and the rest of the line is illegible. "fe-" / "se-" at the line end before "mestrem" is doubtful. "minisferia" and "utplurimum" are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout.
